previous_versions: D-PHY v0.9 (2007) — initial release; HS up to ~1 Gbps per lane.
D-PHY v1.0 (2009) — first production release; HS / LP definitions locked.
D-PHY v1.1 (2011) — added ULPS clarification; 4 Virtual Channels formalized.
D-PHY v1.2 (2014) — raised HS data-rate ceiling to 2.5 Gbps per lane; 16 Virtual Channels via VC extension.
CSI-2 v1.0 (2005) — initial CSI-2 release on D-PHY v0.9.
CSI-2 v1.1 (2009) — 4 VC; aligned with D-PHY v1.0.
CSI-2 v1.2 (2012) — Added RAW20, scrambling foundation.
CSI-2 v1.3 (2014) — Added RAW24; aligned with D-PHY v1.2.

key_changes.summary: ULPS state clarified; 4 VC enumerated; new T-CLK-PRE / T-CLK-POST constraints.
HS rate up to 2.5 Gbps; 16 VC via VC extension; deskew-pattern framework for >1.5 Gbps.
Added RAW20 data type; scrambling concept introduced for EMI reduction.
Added RAW24 data type; further scrambling support; aligned with D-PHY v1.2.
Added optional scrambling, improved error-handling, more data types.

backward_compat_traps.rule: D-PHY v1.x is differential (Dp/Dn pair); D-PHY v2.x and C-PHY use different signaling (3-phase encoded trio).
backward_compat_traps.trap: Mixing v1.x D-PHY transmitter with C-PHY receiver yields no signal; sensors must declare which physical layer they use.

backward_compat_traps.rule: v1.1 has VC[1:0] (4 channels); v1.2+ widens to VC[3:0] (16 channels) via VC extension byte.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Older receiver decoding only VC[1:0] will mis-route packets from extended-VC sources; always check spec version.

backward_compat_traps.rule: CSI-2 v2.x introduces optional scrambling for EMI reduction (not for security).
backward_compat_traps.trap: Receiver must descramble; legacy receivers see garbled payload if scrambling enabled.

backward_compat_traps.rule: Sync pattern is 8'b00011101 (LSB-first on the wire = 10111000); the spec is bit-LSB-first within each byte.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Implementations that drive MSB-first see scrambled Sync and never lock.

backward_compat_traps.rule: Hamming(8,4) extended ECC corrects 1 bit and detects 2; it does NOT correct 2 bits.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Optimistic implementations that try to 'correct' a 2-bit error produce silently-wrong DI / WC.

fields.version_naming_history_note: MIPI Alliance maintains the D-PHY (physical-layer) and CSI-2 (camera protocol) specifications. DSI (Display Serial Interface) shares the same D-PHY physical layer; D-PHY v2.x and C-PHY are sibling physical layers with different signaling. Modern image sensors increasingly support C-PHY for higher per-trio data rates; this document covers the D-PHY v1.2 + CSI-2 v1.3 family. TI SLLA414 application note is a layout-side companion for high-speed differential routing applicable to D-PHY-class signaling.
